Component rebuilding in Victoria

A worn or failed component needs a clear assessment. Talk to Clive about repair and rebuilding options for your truck and heavy diesel equipment.

Call Clive · 0474 372 852

Start with the component and its condition

Identify the component, the vehicle or equipment it came from, and the problem you are trying to solve. A part number or identification plate can help establish the assembly. Photos may help explain visible damage when you contact Clive.

Tell him whether the component is still fitted, already removed or partly dismantled. Keep any available service records and details of previous repairs with the enquiry.

Repair, rebuild or another option

The condition of the part, the fault and parts availability affect the options. Discuss assessment and rebuilding suitability before arranging delivery or approving work. A rebuild is not automatically the right answer for every failed part.

Clive can discuss the work required and the next step. Any scope, pricing and timing are confirmed for the actual job rather than assumed from a website illustration.

Useful information for Clive

  • Component name, make, model and part number if available.
  • Truck or equipment details and the failure symptoms.
  • Whether the part is complete and whether associated parts are available.
  • Current location, access and any proposed transport arrangement.
  • When you need the truck or component back in service.

See the detail, then discuss the job

The component gallery shows ten real scanned mechanical examples. It helps illustrate the type of detail inside machinery. For service advice, describe your own component and its condition to Clive.

Call Clive to discuss the specific part, suitability and availability. Transmission enquiries also have a dedicated truck transmission page.
